description: Use this only when the user explicitly asks to share one of their ChefBear menus or wants a link other people can open. Creates, or returns the existing, public link for that menu. Anyone with the link can view the menu's dishes and prices; the original photos are not included. Don't call it to read or open a menu yourself.

menuId.description: The menuId of the user's menu to share.

name: share_menu
title: Share a menu link
